integrity: Proof is self-contained modulo the explicitly cited classical Johnson harmonic decomposition and Schoenberg fractional-power theorem. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: A complete finite spectral criterion and two asymptotic regimes are proved; no general closed finite-parameter critical-degree formula is claimed for 2k<=n<4k. Historical priority remains subject to independent comparison; computer checks cover finite cases only.
title: Negative-type thresholds for three-capped Johnson metrics: spectral classification and rank-density transitions
